'''Deluxe Bait''' is used to reduce the delay before a nibble on a fishing rod by 67%.<ref name="fishbitetime" /> It also increases the [[Fishing#Bar Size|fishing bar size]] by 12 pixels.<ref name="bobberbar" /> Deluxe Bait can be purchased at the [[Fish Shop]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 4]] for {{Price|100}} each, [[Crafting#Fishing|crafted]], randomly found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching Fishing level 6, or grown in a [[Deluxe Worm Bin]].

Thirty Deluxe Bait are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|River Fish||y}}. The [[Bookseller]] trades 30 Deluxe Bait for 1 [[Bait And Bobber]]. Twenty Deluxe Bait can be rewarded as a prize during the [[Trout Derby]] festival. Twenty Deluxe Bait is the copper tier reward on the 12th for the [[SquidFest]] festival.

Deluxe Bait cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait.

Deluxe Bait can also be used in a [[Crab Pot]], where it decreases the chance of catching trash (if the player does not have the [[Skills#Fishing|Mariner]] profession) compared to using [[Bait (item)|standard bait]] and increases the quality of Crab Pot fish to silver.<ref name="crabpot" />
